grades.quote: An `sc` instruction instance in state Pending_mem_stores( _store_continuation_ ), that has not propagated its memory store operation, can always be made to fail.
grades.reason: Formal memory-model transition stating that a pending sc that hasn't propagated its store can always be made to fail (spontaneous failure). It gives no explanation of reasons in the ISA sense or of the result status, and the text is truncated.

grades.quote: An `sc` instruction instance in state Plain(Early_sc_fail( _res_continuation_ )) can always be made to fail.
grades.reason: Formal model transition saying an sc can always be made to fail early, which shows spurious failure is allowed. It does not explain the practical reasons or what the result value indicates.

grades.quote: RsrvNonEventual indicates that the operations are supported (the location is reservable), but without the eventual success guarantee described in the unprivileged ISA specification.
grades.reason: Describes PMA reservability levels (RsrvNone, RsrvNonEventual, RsrvEventual). This is background on when LR/SC is unsupported or lacks an eventual success guarantee, so it only partly relates to why SC may fail. It says nothing about the result status.

grades.quote: Unconstrained LR/SC sequences might succeed on some attempts on some implementations, but might never succeed on other implementations.
grades.reason: Explains why an SC may fail. Unconstrained LR/SC sequences may never succeed, implementations may fail an SC occasionally for any reason, and the events that guarantee eventual success of constrained loops are listed. It does not state what the SC result register value indicates.
